gbm_population_evidence.quote: Presumptive glioblastoma according to radiological criteria,

candidate_evidence.quote: The phase II study evaluate a light dose escalation in a classical intraoperative PDT regimen mediated by 5-ALA-PpIX, in glioblastoma patients with access to full surgical removal of the contrast enhancement.

The patient will receive 5-ALA ( 5-aminolevulinic acid hydrochloride),GLIOLAN drinkable 6h before surgery + lighting of the tumor bed by a red light source (laser with different J/cm²) at the end of resection

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: This treatment will be performed in addition to the current reference treatment of glioblastoma: maximum removal surgery followed by radiochemotherapy according to the Stupp protocol.

role_evidence.quote: The phase II study evaluate a light dose escalation in a classical intraoperative PDT regimen mediated by 5-ALA-PpIX, in glioblastoma patients with access to full surgical removal of the contrast enhancement.

coder_notes: 5-ALA (Gliolan) used as photosensitiser for intraoperative PDT (light-dose escalation is the question): candidate with device_dependent true (C12); sensitivity analysis 11 applies as it is the only candidate. The 5-ALA dose itself is not varied; the arms differ by light dose. Temozolomide not a registered intervention but all patients receive Stupp chemoradiation; listed as soc_backbone. 11C-MET PET used for routine response assessment, not listed. Arms are three light-dose levels, none a control. Eligibility is 'presumptive glioblastoma' on radiology (pre-surgical).
